description: This file defines a PHP script for rendering a subpanel view in the SuiteCRM project module, including UI elements, list view initialization, and layout editing features.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new XTemplate with specified template file and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
